description: Bell 214ST recorded by aviationmuseum.eu as an 'aviation monument' at Muscat IAP, photographed by Mick Pearson c.2016 and mapped at 23 35 01.1 N 58 16 15.0 E (page title says 'Bell 412ST' but the entry is a 214ST). RAFO operated Bell 214STs from 1985. No serial given by the source; leave blank rather than guess. Location relative to the public terminal / RAFO Seeb gate and current presence need on-site confirmation.
